description: Demonstrates a multi-package monorepo where the root sets target=widely, legacy apps inherit it, modern sub-apps override with target=newly, and shared packages use explicit modifiers.

apps/legacy-portal/src/table.css.purpose: Legacy portal application inheriting root target=widely with CSS block comment directive

apps/modern-pwa/.baseline.json.purpose: Sub-app workspace configuration overriding default target to newly

apps/modern-pwa/src/camera.ts.purpose: Modern PWA app using explicit baseline-newly modifier

packages/ui-components/src/dialog.ts.purpose: Shared component package with native dialog directive
